breakdown.description: Output requests solution at T=1.1 but the Domain section specifies t in [0, 1].
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the conflict between the time domain `t in [0, 1.0]` and the requested output time `T=1.1`. The ground truth resolves this by changing the output time to `T=1.0` to match the specified domain. The agent did the opposite; it changed the time domain to `t in [0, 1.1]` and kept the final time as `T=1.1`, thereby propagating the user's error instead of correcting it.
